abstract: A true teratoma of the liver seen in 20 year-old female was successfully resected. Dysgerminoma of her left ovary had been resected 8 years prior to the right hepatic lobectomy. Previous reports on 8 other cases of true teratoma of the liver were briefly reviewed.
abstract_ja: 20歳女性の真性肝奇形腫を施行し、右肝葉切除術により切除に成功した。8年前に左卵巣のディスジャーミノーマを切除されていた。肝の真性奇形腫の既報8例についても簡潔に文献的検討を行った。
